method: Lagged IRS state tax-return flows + trailing Zillow index + prior ACS owner-value/income, rolling-origin ridge regression. Current-revised sources, not a fully point-in-time archive. Predictions are withheld if historical MAE fails either benchmark.

holdout.limitation: Current-revised Zillow source histories; IRS tax-return lag, state not city migration; ACS lagged, not a verified point-in-time source archive. Model withheld unless both baselines beaten.
